scanNote:
WORKBOOK 19-BET. Unit 4 — shaxsiy savollar, o'qish va yozish.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 12-mashq (13 savol), 13-mashq (jadval + 7 ta gapni tuzatish), 14-mashq (maqola namunasi).

⚠⚠ 12-MAShQNING ENG MUHIM JOYI — 8 va 10-BAND:
  'What's he LIKE?'      → XARAKTER haqida ('He is kind and generous')
  'What does she LOOK LIKE?' → TAShQI KO'RINISh haqida ('She's short and slim...')
  ⚠ Ikkala savolda ham 'like' bor, lekin ma'nosi butunlay boshqa. Bu — ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p chalkashadigan juftliklardan biri.
  ⚠ Uchinchi 'like' ham bor: 'What do you LIKE doing?' — bu esa YOQTIRISh.
  ⚠ Ya'ni bitta betda 'like' UCH XIL ma'noda ishlatilgan.

⚠ 'WHAT DO YOU DO?' — kasb so'raladi, 'nima qilyapsan' emas. Javob: 'I'm a student.'

⚠ 13-MAShQ — YETTI TUZATISh MATNGA ASOSLANADI:
  vet → POLICEMAN · north-east → SOUTH-EAST · on a farm/brother Tom → in a FLAT with wife JESSICA and son JASON
  long brown hair, green eyes → SHORT brown hair, BROWN eyes
  rude/bad father → KIND man, very LOVING father
  football → BASKETBALL · theatre → WATCHING TV
  ⚠ Har bir noto'g'ri gapda BIR yoki IKKI xato bor; matndan aniq topiladi.

⚠ 14-MAShQ jadvalidagi 'Bristol, west coast of England' — Bristol haqiqatan Angliyaning g'arbida joylashgan. TO'G'RI.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing questions, then, in pairs, read out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Tushib qolgan savollarni yozing, so'ng juftlikda dialogni o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
13 TA SHAXSIY SAVOL — tanishuvda kerak bo'ladigan hammasi.

SAVOL TURLARI:

  'to be' bilan (do/does KERAK EMAS):
    What's your name?
    How old are you?
    What's he like?          (xarakter)
    What are your parents' names?

  'do/does' bilan:
    What do you do?          (kasb)
    Where do you live?
    What does your father do?
    What does she look like?  (ko'rinish)
    What do you like doing ...?
    Do you like ...?

  'have got' bilan:
    Have you got any brothers or sisters?

  'there is/are' bilan:
    How many are there in your family?

UCH JUFT SAVOLNI ADASHTIRMANG:
  What do you do?          — KASB
  What are you doing?      — hozirgi harakat

  What's he like?          — XARAKTER
  What does he look like?  — KO'RINISH

  How old are you?         — YOSH ('How many years' EMAS!)

lines.whyUz: Javob 'My name is Linda Richardson' — ism so'ralgan. 'What is your name?' ning qisqasi.
Yosh 'How old' bilan so'raladi va 'be' fe'li ishlatiladi. 'How many years have you?' XATO.
Kasb savoli. Javob 'I'm a student at Bournemouth University'. 'What's your job?' ham to'g'ri.

lines.textEn: I'm a student at Bournemouth University.

lines.whyUz: Joy savoli 'Where' bilan. Javob 'We live in a big house near the town centre'.

lines.textEn: We live in a big house near the town centre.
lines.uz: Biz shahar markaziga yaqin katta uyda yashaymiz.

lines.answer: How many are there in your family?
lines.whyUz: Son savoli 'How many' bilan. Javob 'There are six of us in our family'. 'How many people are there in your family?' ham to'g'ri.

lines.textEn: There are six of us in our family.

lines.whyUz: Ikki ism so'ralgan → ko'plik: 'names ARE'. 'parents'' — ko'plik egalik (apostrof s dan KEYIN).

lines.textEn: My mother's name is Judy and my father's name is David.
lines.uz: Onamning ismi Judi, otamning ismi Devid.

lines.whyUz: Kasb savoli, 3-shaxs birlik → DOES. Javob 'My father is a dentist'.
'kind and generous' — xarakter. 'What's he like?' = What IS he like — 'does' kerak emas.
'short and slim with long hair and blue eyes' — TASHQI KO'RINISH. 'look like' + DOES.

lines.textEn: She's short and slim with long hair and blue eyes.
lines.uz: U past bo'yli va nozik, sochi uzun, ko'zlari ko'k.

lines.answer: Have you got any brothers or sisters?
lines.hintUz: Javob 'Yes, I have got ...' bilan boshlanadi
lines.whyUz: Javob 'Yes, I have got...' → savol 'Have you got...?'. Savolda ko'plik ot bilan ANY (Unit 3).

lines.textEn: Yes, I have got one brother and two sisters.
lines.uz: Ha, menda bitta aka va ikkita opa bor.

lines.answer: What do you like doing in your free time?
lines.whyUz: Javob 'I like reading and watching TV in my free time'. 'like' dan keyin -ING: 'like DOING'.

lines.textEn: I like reading and watching TV in my free time.
lines.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda kitob o'qishni va televizor ko'rishni yoqtiraman.

lines.hintUz: Javob 'No, I don't like ...' — HA/YO'Q savoli
lines.whyUz: Javob 'No, I don't like playing sports' — ha/yo'q savoli. 'Do you like ...?' shaklida.

lines.textEn: No, I don't like playing sports in my free time.
lines.uz: Yo'q, bo'sh vaqtimda sport bilan shug'ullanishni yoqtirmayman.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in the table.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TUZILISHI — to'rt xatboshi, har biri o'z mavzusiga ega:
  1) ism, yosh, kasb, qayerda yashaydi
  2) uyi va oilasi
  3) tashqi ko'rinishi va xarakteri
  4) nimani yoqtiradi / yoqtirmaydi (va nega)

Bu — 14-mashqda o'zingiz yozadigan maqolaning NAMUNASI.

sentences.en: Stewart Jones is twenty-nine years old.
He lives in Dover, in the south-east of England.
sentences.noteUz: 'in the south-east OF England' — mamlakat qismi.

sentences.en: Stewart lives in a small, comfortable flat with his wife, Jessica and their son, Jason.
sentences.uz: Styuart xotini Jessika va o'g'li Jeyson bilan kichik, qulay kvartirada yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz: Ikki sifat vergul bilan ajratiladi: 'small, comfortable'.

sentences.en: Jessica is twenty-eight years old. She is a vet.
sentences.uz: Jessika yigirma sakkiz yoshda. U veterinar.

sentences.en: Jason is seven years old. He goes to school every day from 9 am to 3:30 pm.
sentences.uz: Jeyson yetti yoshda. U har kuni ertalab 9 dan 15:30 gacha maktabga boradi.

sentences.en: He is tall and well-built with short brown hair and brown eyes.
sentences.uz: U baland bo'yli va baquvvat, sochi kalta jigarrang, ko'zlari jigarrang.

sentences.en: Everybody likes him because he is a kind man and a very loving father.
sentences.uz: Hamma uni yoqtiradi, chunki u mehribon odam va juda mehrli ota.
sentences.noteUz: 'Everybody' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → likeS. XARAKTER sifatlari: kind, loving.

sentences.en: In his free time Stewart likes playing basketball.
sentences.uz: Bo'sh vaqtida Styuart basketbol o'ynashni yoqtiradi.

sentences.en: He doesn't like watching TV. He thinks it is boring.
sentences.uz: U televizor ko'rishni yoqtirmaydi. Uni zerikarli deb o'ylaydi.
sentences.noteUz: 'boring' = zerikarli. Nega yoqtirmasligini aytish — yaxshi yozuv belgisi.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N SARLAVHA — odam haqida maqola yozishning to'liq qolipi.
Bu jadvalni to'ldirsangiz, 14-mashqda maqola yozish oson bo'ladi.

structure.modelEn: Stewart Jones
29 years old
a policeman
in Dover, in the south-east of England
a small, comfortable flat
wife — Jessica, 28, a vet; son — Jason, 7
good-looking, tall and well-built with short brown hair and brown eyes
kind and a very loving father
playing basketball
watching TV — he thinks it is boring

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapda BITTA yoki BIR NECHTA xato bor.
Matnga qaytib qarang va to'g'ri ma'lumotni toping.

NAMUNA:
  Stewart is a vet.  →  Stewart is a policeman.
  (Vet — bu uning XOTINI Jessikaning kasbi!)

Bu mashq matnni DIQQAT bilan o'qishga o'rgatadi:
xato ko'pincha o'xshash, lekin boshqa odamga tegishli ma'lumot bo'ladi.

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Veterinar — bu uning xotini Jessika. Styuart esa militsioner.

items.textEn: 2  Stewart lives in Dover, in the north-east of England.
items.answer: Stewart lives in Dover, in the south-east of England.
items.whyUz: Matnda 'south-east' (janubi-sharq), 'north-east' emas. Dover — Angliyaning janubi-sharqidagi port shahar.

items.textEn: 3  Stewart lives on a farm with his wife Sally and his brother Tom.
items.answer: Stewart lives in a flat with his wife Jessica and his son Jason.
items.whyUz: UCH xato: fermada emas KVARTIRADA; xotini Salli emas JESSIKA; akasi Tom emas O'G'LI JEYSON.

items.textEn: 4  Stewart has long brown hair and green eyes.
items.answer: Stewart has short brown hair and brown eyes.
items.whyUz: IKKI xato: sochi uzun emas KALTA; ko'zlari yashil emas JIGARRANG.

items.textEn: 5  Stewart is a rude man and a very bad father.
items.answer: Stewart is a kind man and a very loving father.
items.whyUz: IKKI xato: qo'pol emas MEHRIBON; yomon ota emas MEHRLI ota. Matnda: 'a kind man and a very loving father'.

items.textEn: 7  Stewart doesn't like going to the theatre.
items.whyUz: Teatr emas — u TELEVIZOR ko'rishni yoqtirmaydi, chunki zerikarli deb o'ylaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the table below to write an article about Bill. Write your article in four paragraphs (100-120 words).
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvaldan foydalanib, Bill haqida maqola yozing. Maqolani to'rt xatboshida yozing (100–120 so'z).
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALDAGI MA'LUMOT:

  NAME: Bill Brown
  AGE: 40
  OCCUPATION: pilot
  LIVES: Bristol, west coast of England
  HOUSE: large house
  FAMILY MEMBERS: wife — Polly/nurse;
                  daughter — Lisa/student at University of Bristol
  APPEARANCE: tall, slim, curly fair hair, blue eyes
  CHARACTER: pleasant, patient
  LIKES: reading, travelling
  DOESN'T LIKE: going fishing — too boring

TO'RT XATBOSHI (13-mashqdagi matn kabi):
  Para 1: ism, yosh, kasb, qayerda yashaydi
  Para 2: uyi va oila a'zolari
  Para 3: tashqi ko'rinishi va xarakteri
  Para 4: nimani yoqtiradi / yoqtirmaydi va NEGA

JADVALDAN GAPGA — qisqa yozuvni to'liq gapga aylantirish:
  'pilot'          → He is a pilot.
  'tall, slim'     → He is tall and slim.
  'curly fair hair' → He has got curly fair hair.
  'wife — Polly/nurse' → His wife, Polly, is a nurse.
  'too boring'     → He thinks it is too boring.

100–120 so'z — taxminan 10–12 ta gap.

Bill lives in a large house with his wife, Polly, and their daughter, Lisa. Polly is a nurse and Lisa is a student at the University of Bristol.

wordFormation.introUz: Workbook 19-bet — shaxsiy savollar va tavsif so'zlari.

groups.explanationUz: Har bir ma'lumot turi o'z savoliga ega. Ularni juftlik holida yodlang.

items.baseUz: How many are there in your family?
Have you got any brothers or sisters?
items.derived: Yes, I have got one brother.

groups.explanationUz: Bo'y va gavda uchun ishlatiladigan sifatlar.
'too' va 'very' farqi: 'very' — kuchaytirish, 'too' — SALBIY baho (haddan tashqari).

sentencePatterns.introUz: Workbook 19-betdagi qoliplar — odam haqida maqola yozish.

patterns.formula: ISM + is + yosh + years old. He/She is a + kasb.
patterns.exampleEn: Bill Brown is forty years old. He is a pilot.
patterns.exampleUz: Bill Braun qirq yoshda. U uchuvchi.
patterns.explanationUz: Maqolaning birinchi gapi. Yosh 'be' bilan, kasb oldida 'a'.

patterns.formula: somebody lives IN + shahar, ON the + ... coast OF + mamlakat.
patterns.exampleEn: He lives in Bristol, on the west coast of England.
patterns.exampleUz: U Angliyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'idagi Bristolda yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Shahar — IN, qirg'oq — ON. Mamlakat qismi bo'lsa: IN the south-east OF England.

patterns.formula: somebody lives IN a + uy + WITH + oila a'zolari.
patterns.exampleEn: Bill lives in a large house with his wife, Polly, and their daughter, Lisa.
patterns.exampleUz: Bill xotini Polli va qizlari Liza bilan katta uyda yashaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ism ikki vergul orasida beriladi — bu qo'shimcha ma'lumot.

patterns.formula: somebody is + bo'y/gavda + WITH + soch + and + ko'z.
patterns.exampleEn: Bill is tall and slim with curly fair hair and blue eyes.
patterns.exampleUz: Bill baland bo'yli va nozik, sochi jingalak sariq, ko'zlari ko'k.

patterns.formula: In his/her free time, somebody likes + fe'l-ING.
patterns.exampleEn: In his free time Bill likes reading and travelling.
patterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtida Bill kitob o'qishni va sayohat qilishni yoqtiradi.
patterns.explanationUz: Vaqt iborasi gap boshida — keyin vergul.

patterns.formula: somebody doesn't like + fe'l-ING. He/She thinks it is + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: He doesn't like going fishing. He thinks it is too boring.
patterns.exampleUz: U baliq ovlashga borishni yoqtirmaydi. Uni haddan tashqari zerikarli deb o'ylaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: NEGA yoqtirmasligini aytish — yozma ishda baho oshiradi.

patterns.exampleEn: Everybody likes him because he is a kind man.
patterns.exampleUz: Hamma uni yoqtiradi, chunki u mehribon odam.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Everybody' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK, shuning uchun 'likeS'.
O'zbekchada 'hamma' ko'plikdek tuyuladi, lekin inglizchada birlik.
